source_scope.source_detail_limit: The ODS overview and prototype DDL are comparison evidence, not a canonical schema. Source status codes, mutable snapshots, duplicated aliases, PII and overloaded money fields require explicit correction before ingestion.

verification_policy.specified_definition: Every authoritative commerce asset has a reviewed grain, authority boundary, canonical target, correction decision, implementation evidence and fail-closed runtime gate.
verification_policy.verified_definition: An asset is verified only by non-empty tenant-scoped replay and exact source-to-canonical reconciliation with durable evidence.

正向订单.history_policy: freeze accepted commercial facts and append aggregate-version transitions
正向订单.delete_policy: source deletion never erases an accepted order, item, money or fulfillment reference
正向订单.backfill_policy: resolve tenant and exact source mappings, replay in business-key/version order, quarantine key/status/money conflicts and reconcile header-item-effect counts

逆向订单.history_policy: append entitlement, decision, physical return and money effects independently
逆向订单.delete_policy: source deletion retires mutable visibility but never erases reverse-case or financial evidence
逆向订单.backfill_policy: classify cancellation/refund/return/exchange before replay, bind exact original items/payments/allocations and quarantine over-quantity or over-money effects

支付.history_policy: append intent, attempt, provider observation and ledger effects with stable idempotency
支付.delete_policy: financial and consent evidence is never hard-deleted; revocation and correction are explicit events
支付.backfill_policy: remain blocked without source keys, tenant, currency, amount units and provider status contract; tokenize sensitive instruments before any ingestion

库存.history_policy: derive exact-dimensional balances from immutable movements and allocations
库存.delete_policy: source disappearance cannot delete stock history or fabricate zero; correction requires explicit evidence
库存.backfill_policy: require owner/SKU/Warehouse/Location/Lot/UOM mappings, stable watermark and complete denominator; never invent missing dimensions or quantities

assets.source_grain: one source benefit application or discount row attached to an order or sub-order

id.rule: qualify by tenant and source system; never use as a canonical benefit, Order or entitlement id

discount_no.rule: require a stable non-empty source business key and preserve it for idempotent replay

order_no.rule: resolve through an exact tenant-scoped source Order mapping; never equate text or numeric ids

sub_order_no.rule: resolve to exact canonical Order lines through a versioned mapping; one source row may split across multiple lines

buyer_id.rule: cross-check the accepted Order buyer through an Identity mapping; do not duplicate buyer authority on the benefit

discount_type.rule: use a versioned source-code mapping into COUPON, PROMOTION, ALLOWANCE or CAMPAIGN; quarantine unknown codes

discount_code.rule: interpret only with discount_type and an exact source version; never assume coupon, red-packet and campaign ids share one namespace

use_status.rule: map source status explicitly for migration comparison; accepted Order allocation is immutable authority after placement

amount.rule: prove source currency and unit before conversion; require CNY integer minor units and quarantine ambiguous yuan/fen rows

feature.rule: do not promote arbitrary JSON to canonical fields or events; retain only a digest and restricted evidence reference when required

create_time.rule: parse with an explicit source timezone and retain the raw-source watermark separately

modify_time.rule: never mutate an accepted application, allocation or funding fact from a later source snapshot

subsidy_info.rule: parse only a versioned named-funder contract; require each funder id/type/amount and exact funding sum, reject positional guessing or missing parties

pt.rule: use only for bounded ingestion and reconciliation; never use as business occurrence time

semantic_rules.grain: one immutable benefit application allocated to an exact Order item plus one or more funding rows
semantic_rules.identity: retain source benefit/application id and exact entitlement/template/campaign versions as distinct qualified references
semantic_rules.money_or_quantity: allocation and funding use minor units plus currency; item allocations sum to header discount and funding rows sum to each allocation
semantic_rules.history: freeze allocation at placement and reverse it by explicit AfterSale references, never recompute from current promotion rules
semantic_rules.security: no coupon codes, user labels or arbitrary rule JSON in events
semantic_rules.authority: Order owns accepted allocation; Promotion owns eligibility; funding ledger owner remains external until a settlement domain exists

corrections: replace header-only discount with item-level allocation
separate benefit identity from platform/merchant funding
require reverse flows to reference the original allocation
